title: after install skill, setup hook and setup instructions, with jitso first on PATH, the skill, the instructions and the path are ok
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). Adoption done with the three commands and a `jitso` on PATH that is this binary: `ok   skill-project`, `ok   instructions`, `ok   path: jitso on PATH is this binary`, no `fail` line.
